author: Bahadir Yuzbasi
bandwidth_parameterization: q is the requested training-sample neighbor fraction; realized k is ceiling(q * n_train), subject only to the documented local stability floor and k <= n_train
q_min_reference: 54 / 1560, where 54 = 2 * (26 slopes + 1 intercept) and 1560 is the smallest frozen nested-training size
local_stability_floor: min(n_train, 2 * (p + 1)); a numerical stability rule, not a theorem or a change to the estimator
inner_fold_rule: For outer fold o, each of the four remaining frozen outer-fold labels is used once as the inner validation fold.
full_tuning_rule: Each frozen spatial fold is used once as a validation fold; the other four folds form the training set.
selection: Minimum pooled validation SSE divided by the complete pooled validation count among numerically valid candidates; exact ties require author review.
preprocessing: Training-only predictor means and sqrt(mean squared centered predictor) scales; response remains in natural-log income units.
lambda_anchor: Recomputed from each training set. Non-ridge paths use training anchor times fixed ratios; selected path prefixes are rerun with the refit training anchor.
invalid_candidates: Retain evidence and mark ineligible; do not remove observations, methods, locations, folds, or grid points.
boundary_optima: Report both lambda-path and q-grid boundaries; do not silently expand the frozen grid.

full_gwr_diagnostics.f3_reporting: raw p-values and BH adjustment across the 27 coefficient-specific F3 tests
full_gwr_diagnostics.f_test_reference: moment-matched approximation conditional on the response-selected neighborhood size

postanalysis.selection_gray_semantics: exact zero under abs(beta_working) <= 1e-10; not a significance decision
